results.content: We further demonstrate that the knockout of one of them, WASF3, abolishes actin polymerization at the site of disc morphogenesis leading to formation of disorganized membrane lamellae emanating from the photoreceptor cilium instead of an outer segment. The goals of our study were to identify the entire molecular composition of the WAVE complex located in the outer segment and to directly test whether WASF3 is an indispensable regulator of the actin network driving photoreceptor disc formation. We next showed that the knockout of WASF3 – a protein directly interacting with Arp2/3 – causes a specific loss of F-actin at the site of disc morphogenesis and abolishes the formation of the outer segment.
